events.title: Astra Rocket
events.text: Astra Rocket 3.3 vehicle successfully reached orbit on November 20, 2021, after launching from Pacific Spaceport Complex – Alaska (PSCA) carrying the demonstration payload STP-27AD2 for the United States Space Force.

events.title: i-Space
events.text: Chinese private company i-Space successfully launched its Hyperbola-1 rocket from Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center and sent several small payloads, including the CAS-7B amateur radio satellite into Earth orbit on July 25, 2019.

events.title: Virgin Orbit
events.text: Virgin Orbit successfully achieved orbit on January 17, 2021, using their LauncherOne vehicle to deploy 10 CubeSats into Low Earth orbit for NASA. But the company filed for bankruptcy after a launch failure in 2023.

events.title: Firefly Aerospace
events.text: Firefly Aerospace launched Firefly Alpha rocket, which successfully reached an orbit lower than the expected one, on October 1, 2022.

events.title: LandSpace
events.text: LandSpace became a private company with orbital launch capability by successfully launched Zhuque-2, world's first methane-fueled rocket to reach orbit, on July 12, 2023.

events.title: Orbex
events.text: Orbex developed its Prime launch vehicle, whose first launch was planned in 2023 from Sutherland spaceport.

events.title: Independence-X Aerospace
events.text: The private company of Malaysia Independence-X Aerospace developed an orbital launch vehicle called DNLV, being launched in 2023.

events.title: Orienspace
events.text: Orienspace was the fifth private company in China to reach orbit after the successful maiden launch of Gravity-1 on January 11, 2024.

events.title: Blue Origin
events.text: Blue Origin developed its New Glenn launch vehicle, whose first launch was completed on January 16, 2025.

events.title: Isar Aerospace
events.text: Isar Aerospace became the first commercial company in Europe to successfully launch test flight of Spectrum into orbit on 5 September 2026.

events.title: PLD Space
events.text: The private company PLD Space is developing Miura 5 orbital launch vehicles, whose firsts launches were respectively planned for 2027.

events.title: Tronador II
events.text: is developing an orbital rocket called Tronador II, whose maiden flight is expected to take place in 2030.
